description: Mandate grantor (a person): co-sign one stage of your agent’s deal that is above its approval threshold. Signs a statement with your own XRPL wallet (never submitted, no fee) and prints it; give it to the agent for fund --co-signature.

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

hours.description: How long the co-signature is valid (default 24).
